name: Sayori
source:
Sayori is a more-or-less normal high school girl and a member of her school's history club. She is guided by a mysterious pendant that she found on an archaeological dig and inexplicably trades places with Hatsuhime. She finds herself playing the princess in order to save both their lifes.
Unlike Hatsuhime, Sayori acts more mature and is kind of old-fashioned.
